facts.text: Qwen3 is the latest large language model family released by the Qwen team.
facts.evidence_quote: Today, we are excited to announce the release of Qwen3, the latest addition to the Qwen family of large language models.

facts.text: The flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, shows competitive results against top-tier models like DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro in benchmarks for coding, math, and general capabilities.
facts.evidence_quote: Our flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro.

facts.text: The small MoE model, Qwen3-30B-A3B, reportedly outcompetes QwQ-32B with 10 times of activated parameters.
facts.evidence_quote: Additionally, the small MoE model, Qwen3-30B-A3B, outcompetes QwQ-32B with 10 times of activated parameters

facts.text: Even a small model like Qwen3-4B is reported to rival the performance of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct.
facts.evidence_quote: and even a tiny model like Qwen3-4B can rival the performance of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct.
